At 9+ stack depth, the motion/no-motion contrast stabilizes because high-skill plays dominate, reducing noise. Below 9+, the dataset mixes weak and strong plays, causing sign reversals due to omitted skill variables. The required N ~ 400 emerges from the variance of EPA residuals and the desired precision of directional inference. This aligns with conformal inference principles where sample splitting provides valid uncertainty quantification without distributional assumptions.
